title: CLARITY: Contextual Linguistic Adaptation and Accent Retrieval for Dual-Bias Mitigation in Text-to-Speech Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating linguistic and accent bias in TTS to improve fairness and inclusivity. It explicitly benchmarks its framework using the Fairness Discrepancy Rate (FDR) and discusses its impact on reducing accent-based discrimination in AI, which is a core component of AI ethics.
